done_when: The Board tab shows its summary line for every board that has active work, including one where every item is ready to merge or in planning, and the mounted Board-tab test covers both of those boards

known.title: Not done: test Board summaries in new and upgraded client repos
Not done: The Board tab shows its summary line for every board that has active work, including one where every item is ready to merge or inn

findings.body:
Gain 3, Work 2, Harm 3
Raise: Not done. The fallback runs only when a row is waiting or ready to merge. During a live plan read, Forge still reports the story as planning (`tests/test_board_status_and_times.py:411-417`), but the pane puts its running row in MOVING. On a planning-only board with no go-live estimate, neither side of this guard produces a summary, so the Board tab again opens with a bare group. The mounted planning fixture at `src/forge/mod/hooks/pane.test.ts:317-319` uses only idle rows and misses this normal planning state.
findings.title: Not done: The Board tab shows its summary line for every board that has active work, including one where every item is ready to merge or inn

why: The pane's Board tab opens with no summary line when the only active work is ready to merge or still in planning, so a person sees a bare list with no overview
